The only reason it’s a one star is that I have had this app for months and the supposedly instant reply Toko, never replies. If I ask it something, or even just say hi, which is two letters, it says, there has been an error responding. It’s been like this for months. Im telling you to fix it, bc if your main logo is that ai Toko buddy, why won’t it work? Thanks for your time and please fix this on behalf of a gcse student.

reviews.title: Once amazing, ruined by greed
reviews.text:
This app helped me get good grades during my exam season, this app helped me and by friend group focus really hard. It once was amazing before it forced premium down the throats of its users. Goodbye focus tree, I remember the good times well. 

MY OLD REVIEW :( -

My gf (never studied in her life has done 16 hours in 10 days, our whole friend group has a joint garden.
The competitive aspect (leaderboards and such) really encourages you to push yourself against your friends.
The whole garden-making aspect is really cool and looks great.
Removing apps as well is a blessing for procrastinators.
PLEASE keep this app the way it is! A premium mode that removes some features will RUIN this app.
Thanks a bunch.

reviews.title: Decrease in quality followed by asking for money
reviews.text: You used to be able to allow yourself to use 10 apps while in focus mode. This was useful because I need access to quizlet, kahoot, my camera, photos, Spotify, and messages in case my mom texts me. Now you can only have 3, unless you pay them. They’ve also clearly been fooled by these conmen trying to convince companies that AI is needed in every little thing. It’s not. There is absolutely no reason why this app needs AI. It’s not a studying app. It’s a focus app.  They think that because they offer AI they can start charging. It’s ridiculous. Deleting this trash app

reviews.title: App’s ok, AI usage is disappointing.
reviews.text: I really liked this app. I thought it was an excellent concept, and it really helped when it came to not getting distracted and studying for long, consistent periods of time. However, the AI usage is so incredibly upsetting to me. Most people won’t care, but to those who do, the app is ridden with it now. It takes away the cute charms it had before, and I despise the idea of even using it anymore. I mourn what the app was to me, because that’s clearly gone. </3

reviews.title: Good Concept - But…
reviews.text: The concept of the game is good, but it’s extremely laggy. I was lucky enough to obtain a very rare tile, which would normally cost a large amount of in-app currency, so I was obviously very happy. Unfortunately, when I tried to place the tile, it disappeared. It still appears in my inventory, but I can’t access it or add it to my garden at all. This is incredibly frustrating and has really ruined the experience. Not happy at all.

reviews.title: Premium/ app upgrade
reviews.text: During my gcse season (early summer of 2025) this was my absolute favourite app for studying and me and my best friend would see who could make out garden bigger. Obviously i stopped using it over my long GCSE summer and now im taking A-Levels and went back on to use it. All of a sudden i need to pay for everything about the app, most things that i now need to pay for were the only reason i used the app, mainly being because they were free. I was so disappointed and it resulted in my deleting the app. If your like me and don’t have the mine to be spending on an app, this app is now useless.
